<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<!-- <title>Alexandra &amp; Dennis — December 19, 2026</title> -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Great+Vibes&family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,500;1,9..144,400&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Great+Vibes&family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,500;1,9..144,400&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  :root {
    --cream:      #F4EFE4;
    --cream-dark: #E8E0CE;
    --red:        #8B1A1A;
    --red-mid:    #A52020;
    --red-light:  #C1272D;
    --ink:        #1A0A0A;
    --ink-soft:   #3D2020;
    --gold:       #C9A84C;
    --gold-soft:  #E8D5A0;
    --white:      #FDFCF9;
  }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--ink);
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  h1, h2, h3 { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; margin: 0; font-weight: 500; }
  p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.7; }
  a { color: inherit; }
  button { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; }

  .script { font-family: 'Great Vibes', cursive; }
  .eyebrow {
    font-size: .7rem;
    letter-spacing: .24em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--red);
  }

  /* snowflakes */
  .snowflakes { pointer-events:none; position:absolute; inset:0; overflow:hidden; }
  .sf {
    position:absolute; top:-20px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    font-size:1rem; animation: fall linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes fall { to { transform: translateY(110vh) rotate(360deg); } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .sf { animation: none; opacity:0; } }

  a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible,
  select:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--red);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  /* ── GATE ── */
  #gate {
    position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100;
    background: var(--cream);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 24px;
  }
  .gate-card {
    background: var(--white); border-radius: 2px; max-width: 440px; width: 100%;
    padding: 52px 40px 44px; text-align: center;
    border: 1px solid var(--cream-dark);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(139,26,26,.1);
  }
  .gate-script { font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive; font-size:3rem; color:var(--red); line-height:1; margin-bottom:6px; }
  .gate-card .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 8px; display: block; }
  .gate-card p.sub { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .9rem; margin-bottom: 30px; line-height:1.6; }
  .gate-divider { width:60px; height:1px; background:var(--gold); margin:0 auto 22px; }
  #gate-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
  #gate-pw {
    padding: 13px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--cream-dark); border-radius: 2px;
    font-size: 1.4rem; background: var(--cream); letter-spacing: .3em; text-align: center;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  #gate-submit {
    padding: 13px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--red); border-radius: 2px;
    background: var(--red); color: var(--white);
    font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; font-size: .82rem; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: background .2s, border-color .2s;
  }
  #gate-submit:hover { background: var(--red-mid); border-color: var(--red-mid); }
  .gate-error { color: var(--red); font-size: .83rem; min-height: 18px; margin-top: 4px; }
  .shake { animation: shake .4s; }
  @keyframes shake {
    10%,90% { transform: translateX(-2px); }
    20%,80% { transform: translateX(4px); }
    30%,50%,70% { transform: translateX(-7px); }
    40%,60% { transform: translateX(7px); }
  }

  /* ── LAYOUT ── */
  #site { display: none; }
  section { padding: 88px 24px; }
  .wrap { max-width: 880px; margin: 0 auto; }

  /* ── HERO ── */
  #hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--ink);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    text-align: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 48px 24px 96px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cream-dark);
  }
  #hero .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 18px; }
  #hero .hero-script {
    font-family: 'Great Vibes', cursive;
    font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 11vw, 7rem);
    color: var(--red);
    line-height: 1.1;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  #hero .hero-script .amp { color: var(--gold); font-size: .85em; }
  #hero .tying {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-style: italic;
    font-size: clamp(.95rem, 2vw, 1.2rem); color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom: 36px;
  }
  .penguins { width: min(72vw, 300px); margin-bottom: 32px; }
  @keyframes bob { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-6px); } }
  .bob  { animation: bob 4.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .bob2 { animation: bob 4.5s ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay: .7s; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .bob, .bob2 { animation: none; } }
  .hero-date {
    font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft);
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .hero-date .dot { color: var(--red); }
  .scroll-cue {
    position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    font-size: .66rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--red);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  }
  .chev {
    width: 9px; height: 9px;
    border-right: 1.5px solid var(--red); border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--red);
    transform: rotate(45deg); animation: chevbob 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes chevbob {
    0%,100% { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(0,0); }
    50% { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(3px,3px); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .chev { animation: none; } }

  /* gold rule divider */
  .gold-rule {
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px;
    margin: 0 auto 48px; width: fit-content;
  }
  .gold-rule .line { width: 60px; height: 1px; background: var(--gold); }
  .gold-rule .star { color: var(--gold); font-size: .9rem; }

  /* ── DETAILS ── */
  #details { background: var(--white); border-top: 1px solid var(--cream-dark); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cream-dark); }
  #details .head { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px; }
  #details .head h2 { font-size: clamp(1.7rem,3.5vw,2.4rem); color: var(--red); }
  .cards {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--cream-dark); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cream-dark);
  }
  .card { padding: 36px 24px; text-align: center; border-left: 1px solid var(--cream-dark); }
  .card:first-child { border-left: none; }
  .card svg { width: 30px; height: 30px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: var(--red); }
  .card h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 10px; font-family:'Fraunces',serif; }
  .card p { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  @media (max-width: 700px) {
    .cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .card { border-left: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--cream-dark); }
    .card:first-child { border-top: none; }
  }

  /* ── PHOTOS ── */
  #photos { background: var(--cream); padding: 80px 24px; }
  #photos .head { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 48px; }
  #photos .head h2 { color: var(--red); font-size: clamp(1.6rem,3.5vw,2.2rem); }
  #photos .head .script-sub {
    font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive; font-size:1.6rem; color:var(--gold); display:block; margin-top:4px;
  }
  .photo-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 10px;
    max-width: 860px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
  .photo-slot { border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--cream-dark); position: relative; }
  .photo-slot.uniform { aspect-ratio: 1/1; }
  .photo-slot.engagement-feature {
    grid-column: span 2;
    aspect-ratio: 4/3;
    border: 3px solid var(--gold);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(201,168,76,.25);
  }
  .photo-slot.wide { grid-column: span 2; aspect-ratio: 16/9; }
  .photo-slot.full { grid-column: span 3; aspect-ratio: 21/9; }
  .photo-slot img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }
  .photo-slot .placeholder {
    position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:.76rem; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; gap:10px;
  }
  .photo-slot .placeholder svg { width:26px; height:26px; opacity:.4; }
  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .photo-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    .photo-slot.engagement-feature { grid-column: span 2; }
    .photo-slot.wide { grid-column: span 2; }
    .photo-slot.full { grid-column: span 2; }
  }

  /* ── VENUE ── */
  #venue { background: var(--red); color: var(--white); text-align: center; }
  #venue .eyebrow { color: var(--gold-soft); margin-bottom: 14px; }
  #venue h2 { font-size: clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.4rem); margin-bottom: 10px; color:var(--white); }
  #venue .addr { color: var(--gold-soft); font-size: .9rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  #venue .note { max-width: 480px; margin: 18px auto 32px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.82); font-size: .9rem; }
  .btn {
    display: inline-block; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 2px; text-decoration: none;
    font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;
    border: 1px solid var(--gold-soft); color: var(--white); transition: all .2s ease;
  }
  .btn:hover { background: var(--gold-soft); color: var(--red); }

  /* ── GIFT ── */
  #gift { background: var(--white); }
  .gift-card {
    max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center;
    background: var(--cream); border: 1px solid var(--cream-dark); border-radius: 2px; padding: 44px 36px;
  }
  .gift-card svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; color: var(--red); margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .gift-card h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--red); margin-bottom: 14px; font-family:'Fraunces',serif; }
  .gift-card p { font-size: .92rem; color: var(--ink-soft); }

  /* ── RSVP ── */
  #rsvp { background: var(--cream); }
  #rsvp .head { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  #rsvp .head h2 { font-size: clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.6rem); margin: 8px 0 10px; color: var(--red); }
  #rsvp .deadline { text-align: center; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .88rem; margin-bottom: 40px; }
  .form-card {
    max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;
    background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 2px;
    padding: 40px 32px; border: 1px solid var(--cream-dark);
  }
  .field { margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .field label {
    display: block; font-size: .73rem; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .field input[type=text], .field select, .field textarea {
    width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--cream-dark); border-radius: 2px;
    font-size: .94rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink);
  }
  .field textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 80px; }
  .radio-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .radio-pill {
    flex: 1; min-width: 150px; border: 1px solid var(--cream-dark); border-radius: 2px;
    padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    cursor: pointer; font-size: .9rem; background: var(--cream);
    transition: border-color .15s, background .15s;
  }
  .radio-pill input { accent-color: var(--red); }
  .radio-pill.checked { border-color: var(--red); background: #f9eded; }
  .conditional { display: none; }
  .conditional.show { display: block; }
  #rsvp-submit {
    width: 100%; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid var(--red); border-radius: 2px;
    background: var(--red); color: var(--white);
    font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: .84rem;
    transition: background .2s, border-color .2s;
  }
  #rsvp-submit:hover { background: var(--red-mid); border-color: var(--red-mid); }
  #rsvp-submit:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }
  .rsvp-status { text-align: center; font-size: .84rem; margin-top: 14px; min-height: 18px; }
  .rsvp-status.error { color: var(--red); }
  .rsvp-status.ok { color: #2a7a4e; }
  .confirm { display: none; text-align: center; padding: 28px 6px; }
  .confirm.show { display: block; }
  .confirm .confirm-script { font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive; font-size:3rem; color:var(--red); margin-bottom:10px; }
  .confirm h3 { font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 10px; color: var(--ink); }
  .confirm p { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .92rem; }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  footer { background: var(--red); color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); text-align: center; padding: 52px 24px 40px; }
  footer .footer-script { font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive; font-size:2.4rem; color:var(--gold-soft); margin-bottom:10px; }
  footer .fine { font-size: .76rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); }
  footer .gold-line { width:50px; height:1px; background:var(--gold-soft); margin:14px auto; }

  /* ── REVEAL ── */
  .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); transition: opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease; }
  .reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; } }

  /* ── ADMIN ── */
  #admin { display: none; background: var(--cream); min-height: 100vh; padding: 60px 24px; }
  #admin .wrap { max-width: 1060px; }
  #admin h1 { color: var(--red); font-size: 1.8rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  #admin .sub { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .9rem; margin-bottom: 28px; }
  #admin table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .86rem; background: var(--white); }
  #admin th, #admin td { border: 1px solid var(--cream-dark); padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; }
  #admin th { background: var(--red); color: var(--white); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .06em; }
  #admin .toolbar { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  #admin .toolbar button { padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--red); background: var(--white); border-radius: 2px; font-size: .82rem; color:var(--red); }
  #admin .toolbar button:hover { background: var(--red); color: var(--white); }
  #admin .empty { color: var(--ink-soft); font-style: italic; padding: 30px 0; }
  .badge-yes { color: #2a7a4e; font-weight: 600; }
  .badge-no { color: var(--ink-soft); }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- PASSWORD GATE -->
<div id="gate">
  <div class="gate-card" id="gate-card">
    <div class="gate-script">Allie &amp; Dennis</div>
    <div class="gate-divider"></div><span class="eyebrow">This invitation is private</span>
    <p class="sub">Please enter the PIN from your invitation to continue.</p>
    <form id="gate-form" onsubmit="return false;">
      <input type="number" id="gate-pw" placeholder="Enter PIN" autocomplete="off">
      <button type="button" id="gate-submit">Unlock</button>
      <div class="gate-error" id="gate-error"></div>
    </form>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- MAIN SITE -->
<div id="site">

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section id="hero">
    <span class="eyebrow">Together with their families</span>
    <div class="snowflakes" aria-hidden="true" id="snowflakes"></div>
    <div class="hero-script script">Allie <span class="amp">&amp;</span> Dennis</div>
    <p class="tying">are tying the knot</p>

    <!-- Penguin SVG -->
    <svg class="penguins" viewBox="0 0 400 240" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
      <!-- water line -->
      <path d="M0 210 Q100 200 200 210 T400 210" stroke="#9FC1D1" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity=".4"/>
      <ellipse cx="200" cy="215" rx="160" ry="18" fill="#FBFAF6" opacity=".08"/>

      <!-- Left penguin -->
      <g class="bob" transform-origin="152 160">
        <ellipse cx="152" cy="167" rx="10" ry="4" fill="#000" opacity=".15"/>
        <!-- flippers -->
        <ellipse cx="126" cy="140" rx="10" ry="18" fill="#14181B" transform="rotate(-10 126 140)"/>
        <ellipse cx="178" cy="140" rx="10" ry="18" fill="#14181B" transform="rotate(10 178 140)"/>
        <!-- body -->
        <path d="M122 110 C122 72 182 72 182 110 C182 150 122 158 122 110 Z" fill="#14181B"/>
        <!-- belly -->
        <path d="M138 118 C138 88 166 88 166 118 C166 150 138 156 138 118 Z" fill="#FBFAF6"/>
        <!-- face -->
        <circle cx="144" cy="95" r="3.5" fill="#14181B"/>
        <circle cx="160" cy="95" r="3.5" fill="#14181B"/>
        <path d="M148 105 L152 110 L156 105 Z" fill="#E8862F"/>
        <!-- feet -->
        <ellipse cx="140" cy="168" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#E8862F" transform="rotate(-5 140 168)"/>
        <ellipse cx="164" cy="168" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#E8862F" transform="rotate(5 164 168)"/>
      </g>

      <!-- Right penguin -->
      <g class="bob2" transform-origin="248 160">
        <ellipse cx="248" cy="167" rx="10" ry="4" fill="#000" opacity=".15"/>
        <ellipse cx="222" cy="140" rx="10" ry="18" fill="#14181B" transform="rotate(-10 222 140)"/>
        <ellipse cx="274" cy="140" rx="10" ry="18" fill="#14181B" transform="rotate(10 274 140)"/>
        <path d="M218 110 C218 72 278 72 278 110 C278 150 218 158 218 110 Z" fill="#14181B"/>
        <path d="M234 118 C234 88 262 88 262 118 C262 150 234 156 234 118 Z" fill="#FBFAF6"/>
        <circle cx="240" cy="95" r="3.5" fill="#14181B"/>
        <circle cx="256" cy="95" r="3.5" fill="#14181B"/>
        <path d="M244 105 L248 110 L252 105 Z" fill="#E8862F"/>
        <ellipse cx="236" cy="168" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#E8862F" transform="rotate(-5 236 168)"/>
        <ellipse cx="260" cy="168" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#E8862F" transform="rotate(5 260 168)"/>
      </g>

      <!-- Heart between them -->
      <path d="M193 118 C193 112 200 108 200 108 C200 108 207 112 207 118 C207 124 200 130 200 130 C200 130 193 124 193 118 Z" fill="#C1272D" opacity=".9"/>
    </svg>

    <div class="hero-date">
      <span>December 19, 2026</span>
      <span class="dot">&middot;</span>
      <span>St Francis Yacht Club</span>
      <span class="dot">&middot;</span>
      <span>San Francisco</span>
    </div>

    <div class="scroll-cue">
      <span>The details</span>
      <span class="chev"></span>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- DETAILS -->
  <section id="details">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="head reveal">
        <span class="eyebrow">December 19, 2026</span>
        <h2>The Details</h2>
      </div>
      <div class="cards reveal">
        <div class="card">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3.5 2"/></svg>
          <h3>Ceremony</h3>
          <p>4:30 in the afternoon<br>St Francis Yacht Club</p>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M8 3H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v3m18 0V5a2 2 0 00-2-2h-3M3 16v3a2 2 0 002 2h3m8 0h3a2 2 0 002-2v-3"/></svg>
          <h3>Reception</h3>
          <p>Cocktails, dinner &amp; dancing<br>to follow the ceremony</p>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M12 2L2 7l10 5 10-5-10-5z"/><path d="M2 17l10 5 10-5"/><path d="M2 12l10 5 10-5"/></svg>
          <h3>Attire</h3>
          <p>Black Tie Optional<br><span style="font-size:.82em;opacity:.8;">Even the penguins will be dressed up</span></p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- RSVP -->
  <section id="rsvp">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="head reveal">
        <span class="eyebrow">RSVP</span>
        <h2>Will You Join Us?</h2>
      </div>
      <p class="deadline reveal">Kindly reply by November 7, 2026.</p>

      <div class="form-card reveal">
        <form id="rsvp-form">
          <div class="field">
            <label for="r-name">Your Name</label>
            <input type="text" id="r-name" name="Name" placeholder="Full name" required>
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <label>Will you be attending?</label>
            <div class="radio-row">
              <label class="radio-pill" data-pill="yes">
                <input type="radio" name="Attending" value="Attending" required> Joyfully accepts
              </label>
              <label class="radio-pill" data-pill="no">
                <input type="radio" name="Attending" value="Declining"> Regretfully declines
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div id="attending-fields" class="conditional">
            <div class="field">
              <label for="r-meal">Meal Choice</label>
              <select id="r-meal" name="Meal Choice">
                <option value="">Select one</option>
                <option>Seared Feta Chicken (GF) — Whipped Potato, Feta, Olive &amp; Tomato Relish, Seasonal Vegetables</option>
                <option>Seared Ora King Salmon (GF) — Herbs, Parsnip Puree, Asparagus, Chive Beurre Blanc</option>
                <option>Mushroom Risotto (GF) — Vegetarian</option>
                <option>Child's Meal — Chicken Tenders &amp; Fries</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="r-dietary">Allergies &amp; Dietary Restrictions</label>
              <textarea id="r-dietary" name="Allergies & Dietary Restrictions" placeholder="Please list any allergies or dietary restrictions so we can make sure you're taken care of"></textarea>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <label for="r-note">A Note for the Couple (optional)</label>
            <textarea id="r-note" name="Note for the Couple" placeholder="Well wishes, song requests, anything at all…"></textarea>
          </div>

          <button type="submit" id="rsvp-submit">Send RSVP</button>
          <div class="rsvp-status" id="rsvp-status"></div>
        </form>

        <div class="confirm" id="rsvp-confirm">
          <div class="confirm-script script">Thank you!</div>
          <h3 id="confirm-title">We can't wait to celebrate with you!</h3>
          <p id="confirm-sub">Thank you for letting us know.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- VENUE -->
  <section id="venue">
    <div class="wrap reveal">
      <span class="eyebrow">The Venue</span>
      <h2>St Francis Yacht Club</h2>
      <p class="addr">99 Yacht Rd, San Francisco, CA 94123</p>
      <p class="note">Perched on the edge of the bay with the Golden Gate Bridge as a backdrop. December evenings on the water have a knack of finding their way through a coat — dress warm and come ready to celebrate.</p>
      <a class="btn btn-solid" href="https://maps.google.com/?q=99+Yacht+Rd,+San+Francisco,+CA+94123" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Get Directions</a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- GIFT -->
    <section id="gift">
    <div class="wrap reveal">
      <div class="gift-card">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M20.84 4.61a5.5 5.5 0 00-7.78 0L12 5.67l-1.06-1.06a5.5 5.5 0 00-7.78 7.78L12 21.23l8.84-8.84a5.5 5.5 0 000-7.78z"/></svg>
        <h3>A Gift, If You'd Like</h3>
        <p>Our hearts are full, but our passports are not. If you'd like to contribute to our honeymoon fund, simply scan the QR code below. Having you there with us is truly the only gift we're hoping for.</p>
        <div style="margin:28px auto 8px;width:180px;height:180px;border:1px solid var(--cream-dark);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Scan to contribute to our honeymoon fund" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;">
        </div>
        <p style="font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px;letter-spacing:.04em;">Scan to send a gift</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- PHOTOS -->
  <section id="photos">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="head reveal">
        <span class="eyebrow">A &amp; D</span>
        <h2>Our Story</h2>
        <span class="script-sub script">a few of our favourite moments</span>
      </div>
      <div class="photo-grid reveal">
        <!-- Engagement featured -->
        <div class="photo-slot engagement-feature"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="The engagement — Zermatt" loading="lazy"></div>
        <div class="photo-slot uniform"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Alexandra and Dennis by the water" loading="lazy"></div>
        <!-- Row 2 uniform -->
        <div class="photo-slot uniform"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Yosemite" loading="lazy"></div>
        <div class="photo-slot uniform"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Date night" loading="lazy"></div>
        <div class="photo-slot uniform"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Together" loading="lazy"></div>
        <!-- Row 3 uniform -->
        <div class="photo-slot uniform"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Joshua Tree" loading="lazy"></div>
        <div class="photo-slot uniform"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Giant sequoia" loading="lazy"></div>
        <div class="photo-slot uniform"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="European adventure" loading="lazy"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- FOOTER -->
  <footer>
    <div class="footer-script script">Allie &amp; Dennis</div>
    <div class="gold-line"></div>
    <p class="fine">December 19, 2026 &middot; Saint Francis Yacht Club &middot; San Francisco</p>
    <p class="fine" style="margin-top:10px;">This page is private — please don't share the link outside your invitation.</p>
  </footer>

</div><!-- /site -->

<script>
  const GUEST_PW = '191226';
  const ADMIN_PW = '191226-admin';

  // ---- Gate ----
  const gate     = document.getElementById('gate');
  const gateCard = document.getElementById('gate-card');
  const gatePw   = document.getElementById('gate-pw');
  const gateErr  = document.getElementById('gate-error');
  const site     = document.getElementById('site');
  const admin    = document.getElementById('admin');

  function unlock(val) {
    if (val === GUEST_PW) {
      gate.style.display = 'none';
      site.style.display = 'block';
      initReveal();
    } else {
      gateErr.textContent = "That's not quite right — check your invitation and try again.";
      gateCard.classList.remove('shake');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => gateCard.classList.add('shake'));
      gatePw.value = '';
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('gate-submit').addEventListener('click', () => unlock(gatePw.value.trim()));
  gatePw.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') unlock(gatePw.value.trim()); });

  // ---- Scroll reveal ----
  function initReveal() {
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
      items.forEach(i => i.classList.add('in'));
      return;
    }
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      entries.forEach(en => { if (en.isIntersecting) en.target.classList.add('in'); });
    }, { threshold: 0.12 });
    items.forEach(i => obs.observe(i));
  }

  // ---- Radio pills ----
  document.querySelectorAll('.radio-pill input').forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener('change', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.radio-pill input[name="' + input.name + '"]').forEach(i => {
        i.closest('.radio-pill').classList.remove('checked');
      });
      input.closest('.radio-pill').classList.add('checked');
      if (input.name === 'Attending') {
        document.getElementById('attending-fields').classList.toggle('show', input.value === 'Attending');
      }
    });
  });

  // ---- RSVP submit ----
  const rsvpForm    = document.getElementById('rsvp-form');
  const rsvpStatus  = document.getElementById('rsvp-status');
  const rsvpSubmit  = document.getElementById('rsvp-submit');
  const rsvpConfirm = document.getElementById('rsvp-confirm');
  const confirmTitle = document.getElementById('confirm-title');
  const confirmSub   = document.getElementById('confirm-sub');

  rsvpForm.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    rsvpStatus.textContent = '';
    rsvpStatus.className = 'rsvp-status';

    const name = document.getElementById('r-name').value.trim();
    const attendingInput = document.querySelector('input[name="Attending"]:checked');
    if (!name || !attendingInput) {
      rsvpStatus.textContent = 'Please fill in your name and let us know if you can make it.';
      rsvpStatus.className = 'rsvp-status error';
      return;
    }

    const attending = attendingInput.value;
    const isAttending = attending === 'Attending';
    const meal    = isAttending ? document.getElementById('r-meal').value : '';
    const dietary = isAttending ? document.getElementById('r-dietary').value.trim() : '';
    const note    = document.getElementById('r-note').value.trim();

    rsvpSubmit.disabled = true;
    rsvpSubmit.textContent = 'Sending…';

    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://formspree.io/f/xbgrgjvb', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          'Name':                             name,
          'Attending':                        attending,
          'Meal Choice':                      meal || '—',
          'Allergies & Dietary Restrictions': dietary || 'None',
          'Note for the Couple':              note || '—'
        })
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Formspree error');

      rsvpForm.style.display = 'none';
      rsvpConfirm.classList.add('show');
      if (isAttending) {
        confirmTitle.textContent = "We can't wait to celebrate with you!";
        confirmSub.textContent   = "Thank you, " + name + " — see you on the water, December 19th.";
      } else {
        confirmTitle.textContent = "We'll miss you!";
        confirmSub.textContent   = "Thank you for letting us know, " + name + ". You'll be there in spirit.";
      }
    } catch(err) {
      console.error(err);
      rsvpStatus.textContent = "Something went wrong — please try again in a moment.";
      rsvpStatus.className = 'rsvp-status error';
      rsvpSubmit.disabled = false;
      rsvpSubmit.textContent = 'Send RSVP';
    }
  });


  // ---- Snowflakes ----
  (function(){
    const container = document.getElementById('snowflakes');
    if(!container) return;
    const chars = ['❄','❅','❆','✦','·'];
    for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
      const el = document.createElement('span');
      el.className='sf';
      el.textContent = chars[Math.floor(Math.random()*chars.length)];
      el.style.left = Math.random()*100+'%';
      el.style.fontSize = (.6+Math.random()*.9)+'rem';
      el.style.opacity = .3+Math.random()*.5;
      el.style.animationDuration = (8+Math.random()*14)+'s';
      el.style.animationDelay = (-Math.random()*14)+'s';
      container.appendChild(el);
    }
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>
